newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Sun Resorts and Air Mauritius take bourse lower.
newsitem.headline: Sun Resorts and Air Mauritius take bourse lower.

text.p: Falling shares in the hotel based Sun Resorts and national carrier brought down marginally the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index, Semdex which eased 0.69 points on Friday to 390.20, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 13.68 million rupees on 392,867 shares from 20.80 million rupees on 905,962 shares on last Wednesday.

Sun Resorts lost 1.00 rupee to 51.00 rupees on 8,333 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) climbed 50 cents to 50.00 rupees on 9,115 shares and New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) rose 40 cents to 38.40 rupees on 12,700 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius eased 20 cents to 38.70 rupees on 4,590 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) remained unchanged at 90.00 rupees on 75,825 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) also was unchanged at 12.00 rupees on 121,225 shares.
Sugar based Savannah (O) was 4.00 rupees lower to 146.00 rupees on 9,630 shares. The other listed shares were not quoted.

In the commerce sector, conglomerate Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) climbed 40 cents to 17.00 rupees on 10,489 shares, Rogers was stable at 100.00 rupees, but was unquoted, and Happy World Foods (HWF) gained 40 cents to 15.90 rupees on 11,136 shares.
Industry based Mauritius Oil Refineries (MOR) rose 20 cents to 11.70 rupees on 58,500 shares and Mauritius Breweries Ltd MALL.MZ (MBL) was unchanged to 155.00 rupees on 1,282 shares.

Investments companies Fincorp was stable at 73.00 rupees on 2,646 shares, Policy fell 5 cents to 4.10 rupees on 28,000 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust (MDIT) fell 10 cents to 7.30 rupees on 9,678 shares.
